definition: Hugging Face, Inc., is an American company based in New York City that develops computation tools for building applications using machine learning.
details: Hugging Face's Transformers library is built for natural language processing applications. The Hugging Face platform allows users to share machine learning models and datasets and showcase their work.

explainer.lead: Hugging Face is the place most people go to download, share and try open AI models. Its Hub hosts models and datasets the way GitHub hosts code.
explainer.mission: Make machine learning open and collaborative, so that models, datasets and demos can be shared and reused by anyone.
explainer.founded: Founded in 2016 in New York by Clément Delangue, Julien Chaumond and Thomas Wolf — originally as a chatbot app — before pivoting to open-source tools.
